title: WAQF Framework Prophetic Management Canvas
description: Machine-readable schema representing a complete 1-Page WAQF Execution Canvas (W: Wijhah / Niyyah & Ru'yah, A: 'Azam / Syura & Tadbir, Q: Qiyam / Itqan & I'anah, F: Fahs / Hisbah & Muhasabah) governed by Prophetic SAFT traits and 13 Hadith operational protocols.

primary_dri.description: Single Directly Responsible Individual verified under Al-Qawiyy Al-Amin.

gates.description: Two-Gate compliance status (Gate 1: Pre-Flight P01-P09; Gate 2: Mid/Post-Flight P10-P13).

w_wijhah.description: Stage W (Wijhah · Niyyah, Ru'yah & Al-Miqdar): Goal phase anchored by Shiddiq & Fathanah (QS. Al-Baqarah [2]: 148).

al_niyyah_vertical.description: Protocol P01 (Innamal A'malu bin-Niyyat): Vertical intention before Allah.

maslahah_horizontal.description: Verifiable real-world benefit for customers, beneficiaries, or society without harm.

idiot_index_and_single_fire.description: Protocol P03 v1.3 (Al-Miqdar): RAB Idiot Index ratio (Vendor Cost / Raw Component Cost) and Single-Fire Surge target receiving >= 80% focus (Hell Yes or Freeze).

al_miqdar_targets.description: Protocol P03 (Al-Miqdar): 1 to 3 bounded quantitative targets.

a_azam.description: Stage A ('Azam · Syura, Tadbir & Tafwidh): Plan & Delegation phase anchored by Fathanah & Amanah (QS. Ali 'Imran [3]: 159).

tauqifi_guardrails.description: Protocol P04 (Hubab bin Mundzir): 100% immutable Sharia, contractual, legal, and security guardrails (La Yufti).

ijtihadi_tactics.description: Protocol P04 (Hubab bin Mundzir): Adaptable tactical paths moving at >= 70% data sufficiency.

decision_data_threshold_pct.description: Protocol P04-P05: Minimum Ijtihadi data threshold (default 70%) to trigger timeboxed Syura (P1 < 30m, P0 < 2h).

deleted_bureaucracy_steps.description: Protocol P04 (The Algorithm Step 1-2): Redundant steps or approvals deleted (>= 20-30%) before any ERP/AI automation.

kill_trigger.description: Protocol P05 (Badr): Pre-committed metric, budget, or deadline threshold that automatically halts or rolls back an unviable initiative.

tafwidh_delegation.description: Protocol P06 (Abu Dzar Al-Ghifari): Role assignments verified via Al-Amanah & 1-Question DRI Truth Test (Al-Quwwah).

azam_ratified.description: Protocol P05 (Badr): Whether core executors co-ratified the plan in Syura.

q_qiyam.description: Stage Q (Qiyam · Itqan, Uswah & I'anah): Upright Execution & Coaching phase anchored by Tabligh & Uswah (QS. An-Nisa [4]: 135, QS. Maryam [19]: 12).

definition_of_done.description: Protocol P07 (Al-Itqan): Explicit precision standards before work is marked done.

signal_floor_pct.description: Protocol P07: Minimum Signal-to-Noise execution ratio (WAQF-v1.3 default >= 80%).

goldilocks_stretch.description: Protocol P07: Controlled +4% Goldilocks difficulty stretch above proven baseline.

protected_maker_timeblock.description: Protocol P07: Daily 3-4h Zero-Meeting Deep Work Window (async-first except P0 incidents) defending >=80% Signal without 5-minute micromanagement.

uswah_touchpoints.description: Protocol P08 (Al-Uswah Al-Hasanah): Front-line bottleneck co-location where leader works directly beside builders.

manager_unblocking_plan.description: Protocol P09 (Fa-a'inuhum): Shortest skip-level unblocking path & La Yuqallad guardrails (>= 6h sleep, no 100-120h extreme overwork).

timely_compensation_commitment.description: Anti-mumathalah date or SLA for salaries/vendor/partner payments.

f_fahs.description: Stage F (Fahs · Hisbah, At-Tahqiq & Muhasabah): Inspection, Evidence Audit & Reform phase anchored by Shiddiq & Amanah (QS. Al-Anfal [8]: 29).

mid_cycle_hisbah_findings.description: Protocol P10 (Hisbah / Taftish al-Suq): Findings from mid-cycle process & ethics inspection.

at_tahqiq_artifacts.description: Protocol P11 (At-Tahqiq): Verifiable physical or digital evidence (logs, ledgers, PRs, photos).

ibnul_lutbiyyah_audit.description: Protocol P12 (Ibnul Lutbiyyah): Dual outcome and anti-gratification integrity audit.

external_negative_feedback.description: Protocol P10 (Hisbah / Proactive Negative Feedback): Concrete failure reports or friction surfaced from beneficiaries, clients, and churned waqifs.

pre_expansion_semantic_tree_verified.description: Protocol P13 (Fathanah & Semantic Tree): True when a 5-Hour Trunk foundation & domain practitioner failure-mode interrogation passed before expanding into a new business line.

islah_actions.description: Protocol P13 (Ta'ridh & Bani Makhzum): Systemic SOP improvements without shaming, plus impartial enforcement.
